buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic

Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Office registration Certificate in support of geographic presence is required needs to be uploaded non c ompliance will lead to rejection of bid in Tech evaluation. 2. For MES enlisted contractors : All contractors enlisted with MES in Class 'C' & above d (v) i.e Maintenanc e and Operation of E/M installation shall be considered subject to remarks w.r.t performance in respect of works in hand reflected in workload (WLR) return circulated by competent authority. 3. For other Contractors / Bidder / Service provider not enlisted with MES : (i) All Contractors / Bidder / Service provider not enlisted with MES should meet the enlistment criteria of c ompletion of requisite value works with Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company, a nnual turnover, Bank solvency, working capital and other requirements given in Para 1.4 & 1.5 of section 1 of MES Manual of Contracts 2020 as available in all MES formation as well as MES website (www.mes.gov.i n). (ii) They will also be required to upload copy of police verification /police clearance certificate from police a uthority of the area where registered office of the firm is located/ notarised copy of valid passport of propri etor, each partner, each director as applicable. The police verification report should not be more than six months old. 4. Work order with complete details as well as completion certificate needs to be uploaded for past experience of similar services/work, non-compliance will lead to rejection of bid in Tech evaluation. 5. All the docs in support of bid criteria needs to be uploaded any short fall / not submission of documents will lead to rejection of bid in Tech evaluation. 6. Annual turnover of last three FY to be submitted duly verified by Chattered Accountant. . 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
